text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~... We've got training today.
Guess I better head back to the academy soon—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for real!?
They're doing an all-you-can-eat sweets buffet!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
With something like this, you gotta heap on the sweets
and make a Pandora Special!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~☆ A mountain of whipped cream with syrup poured all over, the abso-lute best~~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Well then, time to dig in right away~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~♡ It's sooo sweet~♡ Absolutely irresistible~♡
This tastes deliciously sinful...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Time to try the next topping~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora became so absorbed in sweets
that she ended up skipping her training.
